messages:
leo: onboarding Onyx13b-int4 reported strange pronoun flips in dialog evals after tokenizer normalizer change.
anika: flips how? can you paste an example?
leo: prompt: 'Tell me what Sara and the team did yesterday.' baseline fp16 -> 'Sara coordinated the deploy.' int4 build -> 'The team coordinated the deploy.' looks like subject/object swapped in ~7% of dialogs.
ravi: did you change rotary or head ordering? or was it purely tokenizer/merge?
leo: conversion notes show: added nfkc normalization and merged diacritics into base tokens, which shifted some vocab ids. quantizer did row-wise packing (pack=16) and emitted head_perm map. runtime load path currently assumes identity vocab map unless explicit mapping present.
anika: so embedding row X no longer corresponds to token id X at runtime. That would explain semantic swap if pronoun token maps to different embedding.
leo: checked: token id for "Sara" moved from 2048->2056; embedding at 2056 looks like a verb embedding.
leo: also found head_perm serialized as little-endian uint8 list, runtime reads big-endian -> head indices inverted for groups of 8. combined effect: rotary phase mismatch + vocab row misalignment.
qa-bot: regression-alert: dialog-suite pronoun-consistency down 6.9% for onyx13b-int4 at 2025-06-11T09:12:01Z
ops-bot: staging rollout paused for onyx13b-int4.
ravi: mitigation path: 1) add exporter metadata fields: `vocab_map` and `head_perm_endianness` and fail-fast if mismatch; 2) loader: apply vocab remap on load if present and coerce head_perm endianness; 3) short patch: re-generate artifacts with prior tokenizer (no nfkc) and keep head identity.
anika: I can push a loader patch that detects MD5 of vocab and applies remap table (if available). also coerce head_perm endian. will include unit test.
leo: small repro snippet for QA:
```
# repro
from redwood import ModelLoader
m = ModelLoader('/mnt/artifacts/onyx13b-int4')
print('vocab_md5', m.metadata.get('vocab_md5'))
print('head_perm', m.metadata.get('head_perm')[:16])
from redwood.eval import run_dialogs
print(run_dialogs(m, 'dialogs-small', max_examples=40))
```
anika: I'll open PR for loader remap + validation and add an exporter assert to write `vocab_map` when tokenizer changes output ids.
ravi: also add a quick calibration job to recompute rotary_scale per-head if exporter produced per-head floats; runtime should prefer broadcast but support explicit per-head after calibration.
leo: thanks — will keep the artifacts offline until we have a fix. tagging y'all in PR.
